fetish_portal.name: Fetish Portal
fetish_portal.description: The first rung of combine_portals' resolution ladder, taken out of the ladder and made solid: a torus at three ring segments, which is a triangle, standing upright in lacquered black. The corridor's own doc calls its ladder 'twenty even steps from a triangle to a smooth ring' and walks away from step zero as the coarse end of a scale. Stood alone and polished, that step stops being a failed circle: three segments is a triangle, and it was always also a torus. The silhouette is the base scene's exactly - ring radius 3.5, tube 0.5 - but the base scene's swapped radii (inner 4 / outer 3, a negative tube radius that turns the surface through itself so every normal points inward and the body cannot hold its own colour) are corrected here to inner 3 / outer 4. It still reads as a chunky faceted form rather than a thin hoop, because three segments is what it is. The black is dark_sphere's, repeated rather than re-derived — metallic 0, F0 restored so the limb has Fresnel, a clearcoat for the second specular lobe, and a backlit terminator; without those a black object is not darker, it is a hole. It transports nobody.
